objective: Promote one ring with matching frontend/API/worker versions, gating observation and shared-contract compatibility before expansion.
banner: Training rehearsal - synthetic data - not a live Azure result

configuration.host: Direct local file in the VS Code integrated browser; no application server
configuration.initialTiers: Internal all-v2, with a healthy fixture observation; every other ring all-v1 and pending

sharedContracts.dual: Accepts v1 and v2 consumers during coexistence
sharedContracts.v2-only: Incompatible with every still-active v1 consumer; rejected before candidate observations

configuration.clockLimit: Window duration and latency are scripted fixture values, not real elapsed-time or production measurements.

coverage: Compatible next-ring promotion with exact membership and per-tier actual paths
Ring skipping and invalid predecessor observation blocked
Requested mixed or unchanged tiers explicitly rejected
Shared-contract incompatibility detected before any candidate observation
Unknown evidence remains unknown and cannot unlock expansion
Completed v1 journeys distinguished from desired v2 migration
Interrupted journeys retained across a later successful retry
Promotion and bounded observation windows enforced
Sequential per-ring observations, keyboard controls, reset, and evidence limits
bdd.execution: Gherkin is the first-written specification, not a claimed Cucumber execution. Node built-in tests and real browser assertions exercise the scenarios.

tddRed.failureKind: Fourteen AssertionError behavior failures against a loadable minimal promotion stub; no missing module, tool, or import failure.
tddRed.outputNormalization: Removed repository prefixes in raw and TAP-escaped absolute locations and trimmed trailing whitespace on otherwise blank assertion-message lines. Assertion text, counts, timing, and exit status are retained.
examples: Matching tiers and observed compatible journeys should promote: expected PASS, actual UNKNOWN
An unobserved predecessor blocks expansion: expected BLOCKED, actual UNKNOWN
Unknown fixture must exercise an observation: expected observation, actual not-implemented

iac.reason: No Azure resource is needed for this SOURCE read-only lesson. C001 runtime/authentication/hosting and the separate scaffold/deploy approval gate remain unapproved.

refactoring: Pure promotion evaluator clones input state and records separate desired routing and actual fixture rows.
Preflight checks precede candidate observations; assertion results drive the verdict.
DOM rendering uses textContent and native labeled controls, with separate verification, impact, and cleanup.
Retries retain cumulative interrupted and unknown target outcomes; only explicit reset clears local counters.

browser.toolDiscovery: Searched deferred tools for VS Code openBrowserPage/readPage/runPlaywrightCode before use.
browser.pathNormalization: The actual open used the absolute local file URI; committed evidence records only the repository-relative path.
browser.isolation: Every browser operation used this unique pageId. No global/shared browser navigation was used.

preflightAndCompatibleRun.result: Passed all assertions; actual clicks and selectOption actions changed rendered DOM.
preflightAndCompatibleRun.observedCompatibleStatus: PASS: pilot. 2 completed, 0 interrupted, 0 unknown synthetic target journeys. Next eligible ring: limited.
preflightAndCompatibleRun.observedPilot: pilot-01 and pilot-02; v2 / v2 / v2; promoted; healthy; 120 fixture seconds; 2 samples
preflightAndCompatibleRun.observedOtherRings: Limited and remaining retained v1 / v1 / v1.
preflightAndCompatibleRun.mixedRequestedTiers: BLOCKED; tier-affinity failed; zero target observation rows
preflightAndCompatibleRun.breakingSharedContract: BLOCKED BEFORE expansion; shared-contract failed and named pilot, limited, remaining as incompatible active v1 consumers; pilot verified routing retained v1
preflightAndCompatibleRun.skippedRing: BLOCKED; ring-order failed; pilot still next

observedVersusDesired: Unknown actual worker cells remained 'unknown'; latest impact showed two unknown journeys and verdict UNKNOWN.
Stale-route target cells were all v1 despite desired all-v2: user-completion assertion PASS, actual-affinity assertion FAIL, overall BLOCKED.
Tier-drift actual API cells were v1 with frontend/worker v2; actual-affinity failed.
Too-short fixture reported a failed observation-window despite completed journeys.
Interrupted fixture reported one interrupted user; a healthy retry passed its new assertions but cumulative impact still reported one interruption.

keyboardInitialAttempt.result: Browser assertion failed on an overly strict exact 3px computed focus width.
keyboardInitialAttempt.correction: Changed only the browser check to require visible focus and a computed outline >= 2px, accommodating browser pixel rounding. No application behavior was changed or failure concealed.

keyboardRerunResult.keyboard: Home/ArrowDown, Tab, Enter, Shift+Tab/Home/Tab/Space, Tab x3/Enter
keyboardRerunResult.mobileCheck: No document-level horizontal overflow; tables remain in labeled scroll regions.

localAssetAudit.limit: File resource timing is empty in this browser; loaded local assets were checked through DOM and CSSOM instead. The request monitor observed no HTTP(S) requests.

verification.verdict: PASS for the bounded portable synthetic A-S008 exercise and its negative gates only
verification.unknownRule: Unknown never passes its own attempt. A later healthy retry is distinct new synthetic evidence and does not erase prior unknown outcomes.

publicationPreparation.initialAttempt: Publisher whitespace gate stopped before any commit or push because genuine Node TAP assertion messages contained trailing spaces on blank lines.
publicationPreparation.recovery: Normalized only the owned RED evidence whitespace and remaining escaped local path prefixes; retried through the same shared publisher helper. No index locks, branch changes, resets, or manual Git index mutations.

userImpact.preflightRejected: NOT OBSERVED; not a claim of uninterrupted users
userImpact.scope: Fictional member journeys only; no real user impact was measured.

cleanup.result: Verified local reset restored pending all-v1 pilot/limited/remaining and baseline internal v2; final reload confirmed NOT RUN and attempts 0.
cleanup.retainedEvidence: RED stub snapshot and real normalized RED/GREEN output are intentional owned evidence, not scratch files.
cleanup.browserPage: Dedicated page remains open at baseline for controller review; no server or watcher is running.

limitations: A-S008 alone is not B-S008 native proof, D-S008 completion, or source S008 completion.
Parent prerequisites D-S003, D-S051, D-S052, and D-S056 are preserved; the A slice itself enters through SOURCE.
No native Azure routing, authorization, tenant isolation, capacity, drain, rollback, latency, or shared-dependency behavior was validated.
No 99.999% proof, uptime SLA, statistical reliability result, or production-success guarantee.
Only eight fictional members and deterministic bounded fixtures are exercised; the 120-second window is not a real observation period.
IaC and deployment are N/A for this SOURCE lesson, not approved for a live harness.
Browser focus pixel rounding required a less brittle assertion; native file Resource Timing entries were unavailable, so loaded local DOM/CSSOM assets and request events were checked instead.
Independent acceptance and publication references belong to the controller result after this evidence is committed; no self-referential eventual commit SHA is embedded.
